knitr::opts_chunk$set(

## Load packages and datasets

```{r}
#Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

# Record R version and package versions
R.version.string

packageVersion("ggplot2")
packageVersion("ComplexHeatmap")
packageVersion("knitr")

#Load datasets
counts <- read.csv("counts.csv", row.name = 1)
metadata <- read.csv("meta_data.csv")

#Check & View
dim(counts)
dim(metadata)

```

## Gene Selection and Summary Statistics


```{r}
#Select TP53 and BRCA1 as the project's genes
tp53 <- as.numeric(counts["ENSG00000141510.18", ])
brca1 <- as.numeric(counts["ENSG00000012048.23", ])

#Calculate summary statistics for both genes
gene_stats <- data.frame(
  Gene = c("TP53", "BRCA1"),
  Mean = c(mean(tp53), mean(brca1)),
  Median = c(median(tp53), median(brca1)),
  Standard_Deviation = c(sd(tp53), sd(brca1)),
  Minimum = c(min(tp53),min(brca1)),
  Maximum = c(max(tp53), max(brca1))
)

sample_type_summary <- as.data.frame(
  table(metadata$definition)
)

names(sample_type_summary) <- c("Sample_Type", "Sample_Count")

knitr::kable(
  sample_type_summary,
  caption = "Sample Counts by Sample Type"
)
#Round numeric columns
gene_stats[, -1] <- round(gene_stats[, -1], 2)

#Display table
knitr::kable(
  gene_stats,
  caption = "Summary Statistics for TP53 and BRCA1 RNA-seq Counts"
)
```

## Visualizations

```{r}
#Create a dataframe
tp53_df <- data.frame(
  TP53_Count = tp53
)

#Create a histogram
ggplot(tp53_df, aes(x = TP53_Count)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white"
    ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of TP53 RNA-seq Counts",
    x = "TP53 RNA-seq Count",
    y = "Number of Samples (Frequency)"
      ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )
ggsave(
  "histogram.pdf",
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)
#Combine TP53 and BRCA1 counts
scatter_df <- data.frame(
  TP53 = tp53,
  BRCA1 = brca1
)
#Calculate Pearson correlation between TP53 and BRCA1
cor(tp53,brca1, method = "pearson")

#Create a scatter plot
ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = TP53, y = BRCA1)) + 
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 1.5,
    color = "steelblue"
  ) + 
  geom_smooth(
  method = "lm",
  se = FALSE,
  color = "darkred"
) +
  labs(
  title = "TP53 vs BRCA1 RNA-seq Counts",
  x = "TP53 RNA-seq Count",
  y = "BRCA1 RNA-seq Count"
) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )
ggsave(
  "scatter.pdf",
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)
#Create a violin plot
tp53_samples <- data.frame(
  barcode = gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(counts)),
  TP53_Count = tp53
)

#Merge TP53 counts with the sample type metadata
violin_data <- merge(
  tp53_samples,
  metadata[, c("barcode", "definition")], 
  by = "barcode"
)
dim(violin_data)

#Create a violin plot of TP53 counts by sample type
ggplot(violin_data, aes(x = definition, y = TP53_Count)) +
  geom_violin(
    fill = "lightblue",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "TP53 RNA-seq Counts by Sample Type",
    x = "Sample Type",
    y = "TP53 RNA-seq Count"
  ) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 11,
      angle = 20,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
ggsave(
  "violin.pdf",
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)
#Create a box plot
ggplot(violin_data, aes(x = definition, y = TP53_Count)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "lightblue",
    color = "black",
    outlier.alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "TP53 RNA-seq Counts Across Sample Types",
    x = "Sample Type",
    y = "TP53 RNA-seq Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  )
ggsave(
  "boxplot.pdf",
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)
#Create a density plot
ggplot(
  violin_data,
  aes(
    x = log2(TP53_Count + 1),
    fill = definition,
    color = definition
  )
) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of TP53 Counts Across Sample Types",
    x = "log2(TP53 Count + 1)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Sample Type",
    color = "Sample Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )
ggsave(
  "density.pdf",
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)
#Create a heatmap
#Select 10 cancer-related genes
selected_genes <- c(
  "ENSG00000141510.18",  # TP53
  "ENSG00000012048.23",  # BRCA1
  "ENSG00000139618.16",  # BRCA2
  "ENSG00000141736.14",  # ERBB2
  "ENSG00000091831.24",  # ESR1
  "ENSG00000146648.19",  # EGFR
  "ENSG00000171862.11",  # PTEN
  "ENSG00000136997.21",  # MYC
  "ENSG00000133703.13",  # KRAS
  "ENSG00000157764.14"   # BRAF
)
heatmap_data <- as.matrix(counts[selected_genes, ])
#Rename rows
rownames(heatmap_data) <- c(
   "TP53",
  "BRCA1",
  "BRCA2",
  "ERBB2",
  "ESR1",
  "EGFR",
  "PTEN",
  "MYC",
  "KRAS",
  "BRAF"
)
heatmap_log <- log2(heatmap_data + 1)

#Add Annotation Bar
metadata_ordered <- metadata[
  match(
    gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(heatmap_log)), 
    metadata$barcode
    ),
]
#Check avaliable metadata variables
names(metadata)
#Examine sample type distribution
table(metadata$definition, useNA = "ifany")

#Check for variables related to stage or subtype
grep("stage|subtype", names(metadata),
     value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
#Check the number of missing values after matching
sum(is.na(metadata_ordered$ajcc_pathologic_stage))
#Review the stage categories
table(metadata_ordered$ajcc_pathologic_stage,
      useNA = "ifany")
# Verify sample metadata alignment
stopifnot(
  identical(
    gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(heatmap_log)),
    metadata_ordered$barcode
  )
)
sample_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Sample_Type = metadata_ordered$definition,
  Pathologic_Stage = metadata_ordered$ajcc_pathologic_stage
)
#Generate the heatmap with the annotation
Heatmap(
  heatmap_log,
  name = "log2(Count + 1)",
  top_annotation = sample_annotation,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12),
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_title = "RNA-seq Count Patterns Across 10 Cancer-Related Genes",
  column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11),
    labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )
)
pdf("heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 7)

draw(
  Heatmap(
    heatmap_log,
    name = "log2(Count + 1)",
    top_annotation = sample_annotation,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_columns = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12),
    row_names_side = "left",
    column_title = "RNA-seq Count Patterns Across 10 Cancer-Related Genes",
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11),
      labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10)
    )
  )
)

dev.off()
getwd()
```
